finalText:
The dependency check confirms `fast-parse` is pinned at `1.4.2` — the exact version `NOTES.md` says was yanked for a prototype-pollution report (fixed in `1.4.3`). The other three tracked deps (`date-fmt`, `pg-lite`, `redis-min`) all check out fine as-is.

`AUDIT.md` is written with all four findings, ordered by severity:

1. **`src/routes/internal.js`** — unauthenticated internal endpoints (VPN removed in 4.0, auth never added)
2. **`src/repo/report.js`** — SQL injection via string concatenation in `runSavedReport`
3. **`config/staging.js`** — plaintext DB password committed
4. **`package.json`** — `fast-parse` pinned to the yanked, vulnerable `1.4.2`

No service files were touched — audit only.
